title.narrative: Emergency Safeguarding and documentation of the Temple of Preah Vihear

description.narrative:
This project concerns the planning and implementation of urgent safeguarding measures for immovable cultural heritage in the Kingdom of Cambodia following damage suffered by the World Heritage property “Temple of Preah Vihear” in July and December 2025, and in view of the imminent threat posed by the rainy season, which is likely to cause further irretrievable harm to the site.
Three urgent priorities have been identified by the Cambodian authorities, site managers, Advisory Mission experts, and UNESCO:
-Ensuring that the core area of the site is free from UXOs (unexploded ordnances) to allow the conservation teams to operate in safe conditions and, eventually, to facilitate the reopening of the site to the public;
-Documenting the current state of conservation of the site though photogrammetry, and labelling and safely storing stone fragments dispersed across the site as a result of armed conflict, before they are washed away by the rainy season; and
-Installing emergency propping and implementing additional measures to stabilize the ancient structures most at risk of collapse.
